Start date: 1263-08-12  
Add 230 days:  

1263 has August (19 days left) + September (30) + October (31) + November (30) + December (31) = 141 days to end of year.  
230 − 141 = 89 days into 1264.  

1264 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-Gregorian but using Gregorian rules as instructed).  
January (31) + February (29) = 60 days.  
89 − 60 = 29 days into March.  

Result: 1264-03-29.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1264-03-29
